description: The University of Würzburg and EMnify publish approximately 4.3 million mobile-network round-trip-time observations collected with MARKlab. The May 2026 Zenodo release covers nineteen measurement nodes in nine European countries and twenty-six anonymised operators. A freely downloadable CSV and README are licensed CC BY 4.0. Each run contains one hundred probes using ICMP, TCP or UDP/DNS, directed to a MARKlab application server or Google Public DNS. Documented fields include protocol, endpoint, anonymous run and node identifiers, country, operator, probe index, relative time in seconds and latency in milliseconds. These observations can calibrate latency distributions and measurement-error assumptions in communication-network simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this campaign. Absolute observation dates and spatial representativeness remain unknown; relative timestamps must not be interpreted as calendar dates. Operators cannot be identified from the public identifiers, and protocol-dependent bias was not independently evaluated.
